messages:
Anya (ML): Quick sync — catalog launch gating checklist. Need final license artifacts + perf profiles for three open models (mariner-13b, fenrir-6b, orchid7b). Who's owning what?

Mike (Infra): I can pick up fenrir-6b perf runs in staging. Will run end-to-end traces and KV-cache warmup sim. ETA: EOD Thu (1725689600).

Sara (Product): I’ll own mariner-13b licensing handoff with Legal. I have the model card draft but not the SPDX. @Kevin can you confirm what you need?

Kevin (Legal): Please upload the SPDX or license text + any third-party deps. Also need model card with training data provenance and attribution. I don’t see mariner in the legal docket yet.

Anya (ML): Uploaded a draft license + model_card.md to the onboarding folder: https://drive.redwood/example/onboard-mariner-13b (private link)

Olivia (DevEx): Heads-up — PR #432 (catalog-ingest) is awaiting reviews. If we don't merge, the pipeline won't pick up the new perf profiles. Tagging code reviewers: @Mike, @Anya. Small reminder to include schema version in metadata.

Mike (Infra): Noted. Quick perf note for fenrir: tokenization mismatch causing ~15% higher latency on our baseline. Repro (run from staging):
```
curl -sS -X POST https://staging-redwood/internal/perf/run \
  -d '{"model":"fenrir-6b","seq":1024,"batch":1,"tokenizer":"v2"}'
```
Using tokenizer v1 yields the expected numbers.

Anya (ML): Mariner uses sentencepiece v1; orchard/orchid was trained with a custom merges table. We need to pin tokenizer variant in the catalog metadata. I'll add a field.

Kevin (Legal): One blocker: orchid7b has a third-party dataset flagged for export-control review. I've pinged export-control-bot. Will need a compliance memo before private deployment.

export-control-bot: Export-control check queued for orchid7b. Expected turnaround ~48h.

Sara (Product): Can someone confirm rollout policy tags? We want mariner on hosted-beta only, fenrir on dedicated-preview, orchid on private-by-default.

Olivia (DevEx): Also add the eval prompt set for mariner to the regression harness. Without that, Optimize can't generate quality alerts.

Mike (Infra): For fenrir perf artifacts I’ll upload JSON profiles to s3://redwood-catalog/perf/fenrir-6b/ + create a manifest entry. Will post link when done.

Anya (ML): Action items recap:
- Sara -> upload SPDX + confirm rollout tags for mariner (due: tomorrow 1725693200)
- Kevin -> review mariner license + export check for orchid (due: +48h)
- Mike -> fenrir perf profiles and manifest (EOD Thu)
- Olivia -> ping reviewers on PR #432 + add mariner eval prompts (ASAP)

Anya (ML): If no major blockers, plan to open canary ingestion next Tue. :eyes: :rocket:

deploy-bot: Canary ingestion window created for 1726300000-1726320000. Please ensure manifest entries are present before window.

Sara (Product): I'll confirm tags by EOD tomorrow. Thanks everyone.

Kevin (Legal): Will review tonight and update the docket.

Olivia (DevEx): I'll reassign two reviewers in the PR and add a test checklist.

Mike (Infra): Uploading artifacts now, will post links shortly.

Anya (ML): Great — ping me if you hit anything that blocks the canary window.
